response: {"texts":[{"id":"DMSR-5774","text":"The DMS shall be able to detect faint objects showing long-term variability, or nearby object with high proper motions."},{"id":"DMSR-4892","text":"It shall be possible to retain small sections of all generated coadds."},{"id":"LSR-REQ-0040","text":null},{"id":"DMSR-6165","text":"Coadd Images shall be created by combining spatially overlapping Processed Visit Images (on which bad pixels and transient sources have been masked), where the contributing Processed Visit Images have been re-projected to a common reference geometry, and matched to a common background level which best approximates the astrophysical background."},{"id":"DMSR-7937","text":"The DMS shall determine a characterization of the PSF for any speciﬁed location in coadded images."},{"id":"DMSR-6892","text":null},{"id":"OSS-REQ-0153","text":null},{"id":"DMSR-6393","text":"For each Coadded Image, DMS shall store: the list of input images and the pipeline parameters, including software versions, used to derive it, and a suﬃcient set of metadata attributes for users to re-create them in whole or in part."},{"id":"DMSR-7886","text":"The DMS shall, in the course of creating the master Source Catalog, create a catalog from the coadds of all sources detected in each passband with a SNR > coaddDetectThresh."},{"id":"DMSR-8352","text":"It shall be possible to detect extended low surface brightness objects in coadds."}]}
